records.name: Rachel Solemsaas
records.notes: Dr. Rachel Solemsaas began as interim president of North Seattle College in September 2023 and was named permanent president effective July 1, 2024, following a national search (Seattle Colleges district announcement, June 12, 2024). She previously spent 7 years as chancellor of Hawai'i Community College and has ~20 years in community-college leadership. The name and tenure of her immediate predecessor (who vacated the seat before her Sept. 2023 interim appointment) could not be confirmed via the college's own site or accessible news archives this round.

records.name: Rolando Garcia
records.priorTitle: President, Judson A. Samuels South Campus
records.notes: Dr. Rolando Garcia was named NHCC president by the Minnesota State Board of Trustees on July 1, 2020. He previously served as president of Broward College's Judson A. Samuels South Campus and held administrative roles at Northern Virginia Community College and Miami Dade College.

records.name: Jeff Williamson
records.notes: Jeff Williamson served as interim president of NHCC following Barbara McDonald's 2019 departure, bridging the gap until Rolando Garcia's July 2020 start.

records.name: Barbara McDonald
records.notes: Barbara McDonald resigned as NHCC president in 2019 to become president of the College of St. Scholastica in Duluth. Her start year at NHCC was not confirmed this round. (Further back, Dr. John F. Helling served 1967-1990 as NHCC's longest-serving, founding-era president.)

records.name: Rick Bateman
records.notes: Rick Bateman is confirmed as BPCC's current chancellor (Wikipedia infobox); BPCC's own website returned server errors throughout this research session, so his exact start date, prior role, and full bio could not be independently confirmed. His start year (~2015, following Henderson's Jan. 2015 departure) is an approximation pending direct-source confirmation.

records.name: Jim Henderson
records.priorTitle: Senior Vice President, Workforce and Economic Development/Career & Technical Education
records.notes: Jim Henderson became BPCC chancellor effective July 1, 2009, growing enrollment ~84% during his tenure. He left Jan. 1, 2015 to become president of Northwestern State University, later serving as University of Louisiana System president and (as of Jan. 2024) Louisiana Tech University president.

records.name: Tom Carleton
records.notes: Tom Carleton preceded Jim Henderson, holding the chancellor/president role for 14 years (with 42 years total in education), placing his tenure at approximately 1995-2009.

records.name: Amy Diaz
records.notes: Dr. Amy Diaz became interim president of GateWay Community College Jan. 1, 2021, and was named permanent president effective April 15, 2023 -- GateWay's first permanent president in three years. She holds a doctorate in educational psychology from Northern Illinois University.

records.name: Maria Wise
records.notes: Maria Wise served as interim president of GateWay before retiring, directly preceding Amy Diaz's interim appointment in Jan. 2021.

records.name: Steven Gonzales
records.notes: Steven Gonzales served as GateWay's permanent president for seven years before leaving to become chancellor of the Maricopa County Community College District (GateWay's parent district); exact start/end years not confirmed this round.

records.name: Corey Marvin
records.notes: Dr. Corey Marvin was appointed interim president of Cerro Coso effective July 1, 2026, after the Kern Community College District board named the previous president interim district chancellor.

records.name: Sean Hancock
records.notes: Dr. Sean Hancock began as Cerro Coso's eighth president on Sept. 30, 2020, with 20+ years of California community-college administration experience. He was appointed interim chancellor of the Kern Community College District (KCCD) on June 11, 2026, vacating the Cerro Coso presidency to Corey Marvin.

records.name: Tim Cook
records.notes: Tim Cook is confirmed as Clackamas Community College's current president via Wikipedia's infobox. The college's own website (clackamas.edu) was unreachable/returned CMS errors throughout this research session, so his start date, prior role, and predecessor could not be independently verified.

records.name: Dan Kinney
records.notes: Dr. Dan Kinney was announced as Iowa Western Community College's new president via a Feb. 27, 2021 press release (per Wikipedia) and is confirmed as current president on the college's own site. His prior role and named predecessor could not be confirmed via accessible sources this round.

records.name: Amanda Allen
records.notes: Dr. Amanda Allen is listed as WCJC's current president (Wikipedia, referenced Feb. 12, 2026). WCJC's own website returned repeated server errors throughout this research session, so her exact start date, prior role, and named predecessor (WCJC had a long-serving president, Betty McCrohan, in the 2000s-2010s) could not be independently confirmed this round.

records.name: Matt Gianneschi
records.priorTitle: Chief Operating Officer and Chief of Staff
records.notes: Dr. Matt Gianneschi, CMC's tenth president, was appointed by the Board of Trustees in 2024 after a decade as the college's COO/Chief of Staff. Earlier career included VP roles at the Education Commission of the States and Colorado Dept. of Higher Education, and service as senior education advisor to Gov. Bill Ritter.

records.name: Carrie Besnette Hauser
records.notes: Carrie Besnette Hauser preceded Gianneschi as CMC president; her approximate 2013 start year could not be independently re-confirmed via a direct source this round. (CMC's founding president, Dr. Joe Davenport, died in a 1967 plane crash shortly after the college opened; the chain of presidents between Davenport and Hauser was not identified this round.)

records.name: Terry Lindsay
records.notes: Dr. Terry Lindsay was approved as WITCC's fourth president by the Board of Directors on April 27, 2026, following a national search. He came from an administrative role in Georgia with 30+ years of higher-education experience.

records.name: Terry A. Murrell
records.notes: Dr. Terry A. Murrell was chosen as WITCC's third president in 2011 following a national search, having already worked at the college for four years prior. He served until the April 2026 transition to Terry Lindsay.

records.name: Robert E. Dunker
records.notes: Dr. Robert E. Dunker served as WITCC's second president for 20 years (1991-2011) and was named President Emeritus upon retirement; the campus student center is named in his honor.

records.name: Robert H. Kiser
records.notes: Dr. Robert H. Kiser was selected as WITCC's first chief administrator/president when the college was organized in 1966, serving 25 years until 1991.

records.name: Daisy Cocco De Filippis
records.notes: Dr. Daisy Cocco De Filippis became Hostos's eighth president in August 2020, after 12 years as president of Naugatuck Valley Community College. She previously served as Hostos Provost/Senior VP for Academic Affairs (2002-2008) and is the first woman of Dominican descent to lead a CUNY institution. Under her tenure Hostos received a $15M MacKenzie Scott Foundation grant. Her named predecessor (Hostos's seventh president) could not be confirmed via accessible sources this round.

records.name: Jennifer Cournoyer
records.priorTitle: Vice President for Academic and Student Affairs
records.notes: Dr. Jennifer Cournoyer was unanimously recommended by STCC's Board of Trustees on May 4, 2026 as the college's next (seventh) president -- and its first woman president -- pending Massachusetts Board of Higher Education approval; her tenure was slated to begin summer 2026, coinciding with John Cook's Aug. 1, 2026 departure.

records.name: John B. Cook
records.notes: Dr. John B. Cook led STCC for ten years, stepping down Aug. 1, 2026 (implying a 2016 start).

records.name: Glen McDonald
records.priorTitle: Vice President of Strategic Initiatives and Economic Development
records.notes: Glen McDonald, a 1986 GCSC alumnus, assumed the presidency Aug. 1, 2023, after six years as VP of Strategic Initiatives and Economic Development at the college and a 25-year prior career at Applied Research Associates, Inc.

records.name: John Holdnak
records.notes: Dr. John Holdnak was GCSC's sixth president, assuming the role in June 2014 and serving until Glen McDonald's 2023 succession.

records.name: Brent Jones
records.notes: Dr. Brent Jones, a Seattle native with two decades of K-12 and higher-ed leadership (including as Seattle Public Schools superintendent), became interim president of Seattle Central College in 2026, following the Bradley Lane/Chantae Recasner transition.

records.name: Chantae Recasner
records.notes: Dr. Chantae Recasner, Seattle Central's VP for Instruction, became Acting President on Dec. 5, 2024 when Bradley Lane was placed on requested leave, serving in that bridge role until Brent Jones's 2026 interim appointment.

records.name: Bradley Lane
records.notes: Dr. Bradley Lane was selected as Seattle Central president effective July 1, 2024 following a national search, and was also named Vice Chancellor for Institutional Effectiveness and Instruction in Nov. 2024. He was placed on requested leave beginning Dec. 5, 2024.

records.name: Sheila Edwards Lange
records.notes: Dr. Sheila Edwards Lange served as Seattle Central president 2015-2021. Leadership for the 2021-2024 gap between her departure and Bradley Lane's 2024 start was not confirmed this round.

records.name: Todd Martin
records.priorTitle: Chief Academic Officer / Vice President for Instruction
records.notes: Dr. Todd Martin became MACC's fifth president in 2024, promoted from Chief Academic Officer/VP for Instruction (a role he'd held since 2018); he previously spent 18 years at another Missouri community college district.

records.name: Jeffrey C. Lashley
records.notes: Dr. Jeffrey Lashley served as MACC's fourth president 2013-2024; he had been on MACC staff since 1996 (instructor, then Dean of Academic Affairs, then VP for Instruction) before becoming president.

records.name: Evelyn E. Jorgenson
records.notes: Dr. Evelyn Jorgenson preceded Lashley as MACC president, leaving effective July 1, 2012 to take a position at Northwest Arkansas Community College.

records.name: Mike Hobbs
records.notes: Dr. Mike Hobbs is confirmed as Georgia Highlands College's current president via Wikipedia and the college's own site (which references his inauguration), but the college's leadership/president pages returned 404 errors throughout this research session, so his start date, prior role, and named predecessor could not be independently confirmed this round.

records.name: Jim Glass
records.notes: Jim Glass is listed as SRTC's president per Wikipedia, but the cited source there is an archived 2012 'President's Message' page, and the college's current site (southernregional.edu) could not be made to surface a presidential bio during this session -- so this could not be confirmed as current for 2026 and should be re-verified. No predecessor or successor information was found.

records.name: Anthony Culpepper
records.notes: Dr. Anthony Culpepper is LASC's current president, having come from the Executive Vice President role at Glendale Community College with 32+ years of executive/management experience in higher education. His exact start date and named predecessor were not confirmed via accessible sources this round.
